ev.q: Atomic Heart is a 2023 first-person shooter video game
Initially depicted as a retrofuturistic utopia
set in an alternate history version of the Soviet Union
the dark side of Soviet manifest destiny
grants powers such as telekinesis, freezing, shield, electricity
Its powers can be combined with both melee and ranged weapons
These cartridges can be looted, crafted and equipped
Players also have to solve various puzzles
"tedious" elements of gameplay, such as fetch quests
